title: Virtua Fighter 2
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター２
overview:
The assembled fighters, each holding their own feelings in their hearts, aim for the pinnacle of strength and wage a new deadly battle...

Two new fighters join! Along with Arcade Mode, VS Mode, and Ranking Mode, it is packed with a wide variety of modes including a learning-function mode, Team Battle Mode, and Watch Mode! Polish your techniques and keep improving!

集いし戦士たちが最強の頂を目指しさまざまな思いを胸に新たなる死闘を繰り広げる・・・

新たに2人の戦士が参入!
アーケードモード、VSモード、段位認定モードはもちろん学習機能モードや団体戦モード、観戦モードなど多彩なモードが満載!技を磨き精進せよ!
